read_sets.note: What each role is told to read. 2026-11-15 condensation (owner A, research-system-maturation): the charter no longer sends the scheduler to LONG_EFFORT_DESIGN.md at start (it carries the procedure and pastes the §2a/§2b briefs only when it starts a reviewer), so scheduler_start is charter, STATE.md, OPERATOR.md and owner-brief.md. Skill ceilings are the sizes after the condensation (research-coordination SKILL+references+charter 139,190 → ~47 KB). MISSION.md and CHECKPOINT.md are excluded: the desk and the templates do not author them. The STEWARD.md reservation (605 bytes, 2026-11-15) was removed the same day when steward feedback moved to topic inboxes. Earlier history of these ceilings: measured 2026-11-11 on programme-three-20261111 (charter 36030, STATE.md 6549, long_effort_s2_s3 17945, owner-brief.md 3292). Read-set ceilings lowered 2026-11-15 to the measured sums: scheduler_start 63,816 → 23,000, scheduler_unit 42,677 → 20,600 (measured 22,830 and 20,452; the rest absorbs the test home's temporary path length), owner_start 21,517 → 8,591. Lowered again 2026-11-15 22:15Z when the charter dropped its copy of the decision grammar (it points to operator-attention.md): charter template 11,947 → 10803; scheduler_start 23,000 → 22,000, scheduler_unit 20,600 → 19,550 (measured 21,850 and 19,394); programme-four rendered 25,450 → about 24,300 against charter_bytes 25,000. 2026-11-16: Raised these bounds for supervisor report delivery and feedback application; the added procedure lives in supervision.md, with brief kickoff and boundary triggers in the charter.
read_sets.owner_topic_note: Each owner also reads its topic's files named here, in topics/<topic>/. They are operator-authored, so they are measured per topic against ceilings.mission_bytes as a flag with a recommended tidy (mission_check.py warns), never a launch gate, and never summed into owner_start_bytes, which bounds skill text only. mission_bytes 40000 is the real spread on 2026-11-12: 25 missions, median 23,266, three-quarters at or under 33,480, two over (local-model-performance 49,806; ai-video-production-and-funnels 71,041).
